reference.description: re-computes all pairwise Nemenyi comparisons of COP path length across the four conditions with PMCMRplus::frdAllPairsNemenyiTest and scikit_posthocs.posthoc_nemenyi_friedman and confirms nemenyiTest reproduces both to machine precision; also reports the firm-vs-foam vision-effect contrast and the significance count
